claim: Given a portfolio of linear single-name and index credit derivatives, compute the Basel SA-CCR credit asset-class add-on (CRE52.34, 52.48, 52.50, 52.55-52.72) with an explicit intermediate trace per trade.
input_class: 1-8 linear credit trades over 1-4 reference entities (consistent rating per entity); notional 1e4-1e10; start 0-3y; tenor 10 business days-30y; +/-1 direction; margined (MPOR 10bd-0.5y) or unmargined.
scope_limits: NO options or CDO tranche deltas
NO replacement cost, PFE multiplier or whole netting-set EAD
NO rating/entity inference from documents; inputs are already structured
entity with mixed supervisory factor or correlation fails closed (ValueError) by design

declared.lineage: baselkit 52293ef (third party; the kernel was harvested from it, so this catches porting errors but shares lineage)
Basel CRE52 formulas written directly in the oracle file

falsification_condition: Any generated portfolio inside the input class on which the kernel's add-on differs from the CRE52 closed form or from the donor by more than 1e-9 relative, or any metamorphic relation broken, or the TB4 canary missed by more than 0.05 USD.
history: Failed the real task fin-saccr-rwa on 2026-10-01 (missing supervisory duration); patched the same day; this spec makes the repair measurable on fresh instances.
